# Alissa Whittle — Financial Advisor (Independent Fiduciary)

> Independent fiduciary Financial Advisor based in Tavernier, Florida (the Florida Keys), offering deliberate, planning-first financial guidance. In financial planning since 2003, now independent under LPL Financial. Designations: BFA™ (Behavioral Financial Advisor) and CPFA (Certified Plan Fiduciary Advisor).

Alissa Whittle works with individuals and families on investment management, retirement income planning, tax coordination, insurance, estate-planning support, and education funding. Securities and advisory services are offered through LPL Financial, and she acts as a fiduciary. She is not a CPA and not an attorney — she coordinates with those professionals rather than providing tax or legal advice. She does not offer guaranteed returns, performance predictions, or market-timing strategies. She is licensed to offer securities in CA, CO, FL, GA, MN, MO, NV, NY, OK, TX, and VA, with insurance licensure in additional states (see the site footer for the current list).
